intent: Loop codex: keep and disclose Codex-saved approvals instead of refusing to launch (#87)
notes: `gator loop codex` no longer refuses to start after Codex saves a "don't ask
again" approval. Gator's own rule must still be exact; approvals Codex appends
after it are kept byte-for-byte, parsed with a closed `prefix_rule` grammar
(never evaluated), and listed before every launch and in `--dry-run` with
recognised credentials hidden. Unreadable or unshowable content still refuses
with nothing written, and the message names only the approval's position.
